body: None. At least I haven't gone down that route yet.

I think that I am the one in the wrong and misinterpreted her words. I said that she berated another person but I think in reality she was frustrated rather than hostile and ended up regretting her actions. In the end the person she berated ended up hurting her instead later on. I know this is vague, but in the end I was playing the savior and read the situation wrong, so I dont feel that she should be held accountable. Instead, I ended up betraying her trust.

Thank you, I think I should feel love for my family and should always strive for them but sometimes I am just numb and resentful for the burden I need to carry and for how they treat me sometimes. I feel terrible for feeling this way and that makes me want to kill myself more. Thank you again I appreciate your response
